pro_course_detail.title: Cambridge A2 KET Exam Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Cambridge KET Exam Preparation  

This course is designed to fully prepare your child for the Cambridge KET exam, ensuring they build a strong foundation in English. I use the Complete KET Student’s Book and Workbook to cover all essential grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills. Throughout the course, we will also incorporate practice tests to track progress and determine when your child is test-ready. If additional support is needed, we will use the Exam Booster for extra exam-style practice.  

The time required to prepare for KET depends on your child’s current level. It can take up to a year or more to fully develop the necessary skills to excel in the exam. My goal is not just to help them pass but to ensure they build a solid foundation for future exams like PET and FCE.  

Many students pass KET and PET based on their speaking ability alone, without mastering grammar. However, when they reach FCE, they struggle due to gaps in their grammar knowledge. That is why I emphasize a balanced approach, making sure your child is exposed to all key language areas so they can progress confidently through the Cambridge levels.  

By focusing on strong grammar, vocabulary, reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills in KET, your child will be well-prepared for future challenges. Investing in their foundation now will make their English journey smoother, and their future self will thank you.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS
pro_course_detail.description:
I believe in keeping things simple and using clear, straightforward language to help you achieve your desired band score. Many people assume that using advanced vocabulary is necessary for a high score. While that can be true to some extent, if you are not able to use advanced words correctly, it may lower your score. That is why I focus on essential linking words that can effectively improve your performance.  

In our lessons, we will explore conditional sentences with "if" to discuss possible situations, helping you express ideas with confidence. We will also work on expanding your vocabulary with words like "more," which indicate an increase in quantity or degree, enriching your writing without making it too complex.  

A key part of our sessions will be learning how to connect and extend ideas smoothly. I will show you how to use "and" and "also" to add information naturally, and how to emphasize important points with "not only... but also." We will practice using "to" and "the" for clarity and specificity, and I will explain how "which" can be used to add extra details about a noun, making your sentences clearer and more precise.  

I will encourage you to reflect on your progress, helping you think carefully about what you have learned and how to apply it effectively. We will also work on cause and effect by using "because" to explain reasons, "therefore" to show logical conclusions, and "so" to indicate results, allowing you to create well-structured arguments.  

Finally, I will guide you in using "when" to refer to specific situations and teach you how to introduce contrasting ideas with "but" or "however." With this approach, you will not only prepare effectively for your exams but also develop a strong foundation in English.  

Together, we will work towards your success.

I immediately became an English teacher after graduating college 2 years ago. I began teaching online through a platform known as VIP-Kid. I taught 2-14 year old Chinese children/teens English. Last year, I taught English in person at a local Korean private school. I have taught 5-20 year old Koreans in person. teacher_info.teaching_style:
I believe that enjoying yourself while learning a language is very important. Therefore, one of the first questions will be, "What interests or hobbies do you have?" I will then create curriculum based on what you mentioned. I am a conversational teacher who is outgoing, energetic and active. If you are interested, we can learn English through song lyrics, books, social media posts, sports videos, and dramas/movies. I can even teach you English through Tae Kwon Do lessons or by doing your favorite activity together. 
  I will often use Quizlet, Google Drive, Docs, and PowerPoint to relay new vocabulary and grammar structures that we learn during classroom activities or conversations.

course_info.trial_description:
Trial Lesson structure:       

        First, we will get to know each other and have a time for questions. Feel free to ask me any question. I look forward to learning about you and your goals. Then, I will briefly explain my lesson structure and teaching method. Next, based on a topic of your interest, I will come up with a dialogue or use a piece from the internet to learn more about you and this topic. Then, we will practice reading this dialogue together and focus on pronunciation. I will then make a Google Document for us to share, listing new vocabulary or grammar structures. We will then make fun sentences together using these words. 

Homework and Tests: 

      Depending on your level of interest, I can create homework and tests to evaluate your progress. But you get to control your learning pace and therefore do not have to take a single test or have any homework if that is your desire. My main focus is to help make learning fun for you so that you will feel motivated to learn more. So if you want a more or less interactive lesson, please let me know. 

About me: 
      I have had over 2 years of teaching experience. I have taught English to Chinese students online for a year and have taught English to Korean students in person for a year. I am extroverted and love meeting new people. I am open to adjusting lessons to better suit you. So let me know if you want to learn English by watching movies, reading books, cooking together, singing, dancing or doing some other activity. I can also speak some Mandarin Chinese and Korean if you need some help in translation. But our main focus, of course, will be communicating in English. I look forward to meeting you!

pro_course_detail.title: English Basics for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Description: 

        In this lesson you will learn how to introduce yourself and will be able to have a small conversation with English speakers. We will mainly focus on pronunciation, speaking, grammar and listening through a dialogue written in Google Documents. If desired, we can also work on spelling and writing. The main goal of this lesson is to help you sound like a native English speaker. I also hope that you will have fun in introducing yourself. I will help you be as creative as you want in your introduction so we can have a lively conversation. I will also change my introduction occasionally in order to make our dialogue more similar to a natural conversation with a native English speaker and to help improve your confidence. 

Teaching materials:

I will be using Google documents so we can share the vocabulary, grammar, and dialogues that we practiced during class. I will also use quizlet, powerpoint, youtube, and other fun learning apps/websites to further your learning. If desired, we can also use books, social media websites, movies, and more. 

Tests and Homework:

You get to decide how much homework and how many tests you want to have. Based on your desired learning pace, we can discuss the amount.
